stories.text: As an operator, I want my existing conforming Channels MCP server to connect to Norn and retain its first pushed message.
As an operator, I want explicit inbox policy and bounded retained work without stalling tool replies or confusing source identity.
As a Rust server author, I want a real stdio fixture proving the public contract without JavaScript.
As an operator, I want busy and idle running sessions to receive messages through their existing owned lifecycle.
As an operator, I want to see enabled sources, pending inbox messages and refusals and change admission through existing controls.
As an operator, I want Cambium and Hammerbarn interoperability demonstrated without unearned delivery guarantees.
